IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Kirby, Bailey, Hurst, Roach, Simpson, and Morrell

IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Financial Institutions & Insurance.

Bill.BriefDescription: Clarifying the ability to charge residential mortgage loan fees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to residential mortgage loan fees; and adding a newsection to chapter 19.144 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.144 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not prohibit a financial institution fromcharging fees, including discount points, permitted by the federalhousing administration in connection with a residential mortgage loaninsured by the federal housing administration or permitted by thefederal veterans administration in connection with a residentialmortgage loan under the federal veterans administration home loanguaranty program.
